title: Sunday mornings in Cubbon Park
excerpt: The same loop every week, and it is never quite the same walk.
body:
Most Sundays I walk the same loop in Cubbon Park before the city wakes up properly.

It's never the same walk. Some weeks it's dog walkers and joggers. Some weeks it's a school group, or a man practising the flute under the same tree. Once it was a wedding photoshoot at 7 a.m.

An hour of walking with no destination is the closest I get to switching off.
